user.title: Connect to your feeder
user.description: Enter the address of the feeder running the Kibble agent.

error.cannot_connect: No Kibble agent answered at that address.
error.unknown: The agent answered but the response could not be read.

abort.already_configured: This feeder is already set up.

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Dispense food from one or both augers.

hopper.name: Hopper
hopper.description: Which auger to run. The divider may be removed, in which case both draw from one bin.

id.name: Feed ID
id.description: Optional identifier recorded with the feed event.

cancel_feed.name: Cancel feed
cancel_feed.description: Stop a dispense that is in progress.

schedule_set.name: Set schedule
schedule_set.description: Replace the whole feed schedule with a new list of entries.

entries.name: Entries
entries.description: The full replacement list, each with time, hopper1_g, hopper2_g and optionally enabled/entry_id.

schedule_add.name: Add schedule entry
schedule_add.description: Add one entry to the feed schedule.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to add an entry to.

schedule_remove.name: Remove schedule entry
schedule_remove.description: Remove one entry from the feed schedule.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to remove an entry from.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: The id from sensor.cat_feeder_schedule's entries attribute.

schedule_set_enabled.name: Enable/disable schedule entry
schedule_set_enabled.description: Turn one feed-schedule entry on or off without removing it.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: The id from sensor.cat_feeder_schedule's entries attribute.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the entry should be active.

wifi_connect.name: Connect to Wi-Fi network
wifi_connect.description: Switch the feeder to a different Wi-Fi network, or reconnect to one it already has a saved password for. Fails safe: a wrong password or unreachable network rolls back to the previous connection automatically.

ssid.name: Network name (SSID)
ssid.description: The Wi-Fi network to connect to.

password.name: Password
password.description: Leave empty to reconnect to a network Kibble already has a saved password for.

label_face.name: Label face
label_face.description: Move a pending face crop into a cat's permanent storage and train the identifier on it.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to label a crop on.

crop_id.name: Crop ID
crop_id.description: The pending crop's filename, from image.cat_feeder_pending_face's attributes or GET /faces/pending.

cat.name: Cat
cat.description: The cat's name, or "other"/"not_a_cat" to skip training on this crop.

add_cat.name: Add cat
add_cat.description: Pre-register a cat with zero samples, so it appears as a label option before its first crop is labelled.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to add a cat to.

identify.name: Identify now
identify.description: Force an immediate identification of the newest pending crop and refresh the last-seen-pet sensor.

save_clip.name: Save clip
save_clip.description: Download audio from an HA media source or URL, convert it, and store it on the feeder as a named clip.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to save a clip on.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: A media-source reference (e.g. from tts.speak) or a direct audio URL.

record_clip.name: Record clip
record_clip.description: Record from the feeder's own microphone and store it on the feeder as a named clip.

play_clip.name: Play clip
play_clip.description: Play an already-stored clip through the feeder's speaker.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to play a clip on.

name.name: Clip name
name.description: The stored clip's name, from sensor.cat_feeder_clips's attributes or GET /clips.

init.title: Video source & Bluetooth fallback
init.description:
The feeder serves its video to one consumer only — Scrypted. Paste Scrypted's rebroadcast URL for the feeder here so Home Assistant consumes that instead of opening a second stream on the device. Leave empty to use the device directly.

If the feeder's BLE MAC is known (once a Bluetooth proxy has seen it advertise), feed commands fall back to Bluetooth whenever the agent's Wi-Fi API is unreachable. Leave empty to disable the fallback.

error.not_mac: Must be a MAC address, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
